claim_text: AWS temporal counters are scoped to caller-supplied sessions; a new session starts a new count and the maximum temporal look-back is 24 hours.
notes: Feature-scoped statement, not a claim that no AWS service or custom application can share budgets.

claim_text: The official AgentCore temporal sample FAQ says temporal policies cannot span sessions or aggregate across principals and discourages an application-wide session ID.
notes: A controlled same-session workflow can already satisfy some task constraints.

claim_text: Arcade native rate limits count before tool execution, share counters among callers in the bound scope, apply separately per matched tool and reset in fixed clock windows.
notes: Do not claim Arcade has no shared counters; documented distinction is cross-tool aggregation and task-lifetime scope.

claim_text: LiteLLM already documents shared LLM budgets, maximum-cost reservation before dispatch and stricter fail-closed configuration.
notes: Disconfirms a generic new product for parallel LLM budget reservations.

claim_text: LiteLLM says full batch-job cost cannot be reserved from an input_file_id at submission, and some non-token-priced routes use recorded spend.
notes: Documented route-specific limit; not proof INVARIANT can solve arbitrary provider pricing or batch admission.

claim_text: Portkey documents budget controls integrated with parallel coding-agent sessions.
notes: Vendor description; no independent exact-ceiling efficacy claim.

claim_text: A vendor-hosted Wayfair account describes parallel agent-driven research experiments.
notes: Not evidence that Wayfair experiences the budget problem or would purchase INVARIANT.

claim_text: A conserved task-lifetime allowance spanning separate sessions, principals, tools and restarts is a different control from the reviewed native temporal and per-tool rate-limit features.
notes: Engineering inference and proposed control semantics. The 300-attempt example is hypothetical; daily prevalence and willingness to pay are unmeasured. Feasibility requires complete mediation, durable admission and bound operation costs.

claim_text: Investigate residual job-budget work after correctly configuring existing gateways; do not build another generic LLM budget proxy or declare a validated market opening.
notes: Product opportunity is conditional; custom extensions or an existing shared budget may be sufficient.
